name: handrail
displayName: Handrail: Memory and Guardrails for Claude Code
description: Something to hold onto while you learn Claude Code. Seven skills write and refine your global CLAUDE.md, capture new rules the moment they come up, give a project a memory that survives between sessions, and get independent takes on a draft or a verdict before it ships, and two opt-in hooks enforce the rules a markdown file can only ask for.
